GOTCHA: src/core/store.ts updateMemory() only persists fields in an explicit whitelist.

SYMPTOM: Setting superseded_by or related_to on project memories had no effect — fields silently dropped.

CAUSE: updateMemory() has a hardcoded list of allowed fields. New fields added to StoredMemory type aren't automatically persisted.

FIX APPLIED: Added superseded_by and related_to to the whitelist.

PREVENT: Any time you add a new field to StoredMemory interface, ALSO add it to updateMemory()'s whitelist in store.ts. Check the field list before assuming a store update is working.
